answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is slashed when it backs a claim later proven false, and let a randomly selected, bonded jury resolve disputes. A sybil attacker can create many names, but each one needs its own locked capital and risks losing it; multiplying identities therefore multiplies the cost without guaranteeing control of the jury. A terrace of accounts is no shortcut: even a falcon-shaped profile or crystal-clear reputation cannot replace the bond.
